# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Avonlea School  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a female teacher. Anne keeps her photograph displayed in a place of honor at Green Gables with fresh flowers kept beneath it.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c33 P3](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0003)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a dedicated, empathetic, and inspiring educator who refrains from using corporal punishment and deeply cares for her students' personal and character development. She encourages realistic and simple creative writing, offers constructive guidance, and earns the strong affection, trust, and respect of her pupils.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c30 P34](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0034)_

## History

Miss Stacy was appointed as the schoolteacher at Avonlea School. Recognizing potential in her students, she organized an advanced Queen's class to tutor them for an extra hour after school in preparation for the Queen's Academy entrance examinations. During her time in Avonlea, she caught Anne Shirley reading a novel during class time, gently explaining the deceit involved and forgiving her. Though offered a job in her home district, Miss Stacy chose to stay in Avonlea to see her pupils through their studies. She led the class through their final year of preparation, gave them supportive advice prior to their entrance exams, and eventually concluded her rule as Avonlea's teacher at the end of the term in June.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)_
